column1: # Altmiller cave: invisible Babi, Mystic Draught, uncertainty, Alchemy speculation, Colosso invitation and rock interaction.

column3: You... can you really see\nme?{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, are you serious?\nWe haven't even seen the\nman we're supposed to help!{end_wait}
He says he's trapped and\ncan't move. If that's true,\nwe can't just leave him{page_break}here.{end_wait}
I'm not sure about this,\n{actor_name:1}. We have no way to\ntell who's speaking to us.{end_wait}
Wait. Don't go yet.{end_wait}
Have you forgotten the\norder of the colored rocks?{end_now}
If they don't bring the\ndraught back soon... I\ndon't know how much longer{page_break}I can last.{end_wait}
You came back. Please, give\nme the draught before I\nlose my strength again.{end_wait}
I would have shown myself\nearlier if I could. I\ncouldn't even move.{end_wait}
You took that rather\ncalmly. I suppose you've\nseen stranger things on{page_break}your travels.{end_wait}
How could you be invisible\nand unable to move at the\nsame time?{end_wait}
Kraden said Alchemy might\neven overcome death itself.\nDo you remember?{end_wait}
Kraden told us Alchemy\ncould defy death. I haven't\nforgotten that.{end_wait}
Wait. What did you just\nsay?{end_wait}
Babi?!{end_wait}
So, we're going to enter\nColosso?{end_wait}
You don't want to enter\neither, do you?{end_wait}
We're staying in Tolbi\nuntil Colosso ends anyway.\nWe might as well see it{page_break}through.{end_wait}
Then it's decided. Let's\nmake the best of it.{end_wait}
What? After all that,\nyou're backing out?{end_wait}
{protagonist_name} turned the rock.{end_wait}
